name: us-energy-and-clean-vehicle-credits-2026
description: What the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (Public Law 119-21) ended for individual US taxpayers, and when, and what is still claimable on a 2026 Form 1040. Covers the new clean vehicle credit (section 30D) and the previously-owned clean vehicle credit (section 25E), both ended for vehicles acquired after 30 September 2025, with the IRS meaning of "acquired" (a written binding contract plus a payment); the energy efficient home improvement credit (section 25C), ended for property placed in service after 31 December 2025; the residential clean energy credit (section 25D), ended for expenditures made after 31 December 2025, with its carryforward of unused credit into 2026; and the alternative fuel vehicle refueling property credit (section 30C), ended for property placed in service after 30 June 2026.
